summary: TORGGATA 9 BORETTSLAG (org. no. 991 073 965) is a housing cooperative (BRL) based in Rana, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-04-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.4 m and net income was NOK 193 403. Board chair: Eilif Eide; auditor: HELGELAND REVISJON AS.
